name: Helen Dean
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am an Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) and registered counsellor with ACA and have over 25 years of experience. I specialise in working with children, adolescents, and adults with eating disorders (including Anorexia Nervosa; Bulimia Nervosa; Binge Eating Disorder; Avoidant Restrictive Eating Disorders (ARFID) & Atypical Anorexia Nervosa (ANN); disordered eating, and body image issues. As a registered counsellor I also provide therapy for individuals with anxiety, mood disorders, trauma, school refusal, and relationship issues as well as provide family therapy and counselling.

name: Jennifer Allen
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Counselling Jen brings you over 25 years of practice and expertise in her exploration of what it is to be in relationship with self and other. Jen works with people dealing with a wide range of issues, including anxiety, addictions, trauma, relationship difficulties, and more, providing a safe and confidential space for clients to gain insights and achieve lasting personal growth and well-being.
